_note: Run mechanics -- how a batch actually executes, independent of which league/decks. checkpoint_opponent_rate is the one field expected to be overridden per-invocation on purpose (e.g. a sub-league's planned 0.0 -> 0.20 switch at ~10k games/deck) rather than edited here. games_per_iteration, the PPO batch-size ramp (batch_size_start/cap/steps), and max_batch_size (league_*.json) used to live here too -- removed 2026-07-31: games_per_iteration is now always derived as max(1, n_workers) (one game per worker; see run_league.py main()'s own comment for the benchmark that grounded it), the PPO ramp is hardcoded in rl.train.batch_size_for_iteration (nobody had ever overridden it), and max_batch_size's safety role is now covered by the escalation loop (webapp / the /train skill) health-checking between every batch.
_league_note: ROLE SWAP + RENAME (2026-08-05): 4_deck_subleague_test trained to ~55,000 games/deck under PFSP for its last ~45,000 games but plateaued flat around 46-48% vs its gauntlet twin the whole stretch (see SWAP_EXPERIMENT.md at the repo root for the full writeup) -- its first ~10,000 games predate PFSP entirely, hypothesized as the cause. The OTHER population (PFSP from game 1, previously named 4_deck_subleague_gauntlet) took over as the actively-trained population instead; the two checkpoint directories were then RENAMED to match their current roles, so this config's own league_name/gauntlet_league_name fields below did not need to change -- 4_deck_subleague_test is now (and going forward) whichever population is actively training, 4_deck_subleague_gauntlet is the frozen reference. See training_configs/run_gauntlet.json for why it's retired rather than reused.
